translation.title: Insect Bites and Itching Plaster
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for insect bites, itching and chilblains.
translation.usage: Apply one patch at a time to the affected area once to several times a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: people who are hypersensitive to this medicine; children under 30 months of age. Do not use this medicine in the following cases: the eyes or the area around the eyes; mucous membranes; eczema; dermatitis caused by lacquer or the like; wounded areas; sensitive skin. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people who have experienced allergic symptoms (such as rash, redness, itching or dermatitis caused by lacquer) from medicines or cosmetics; people with an allergic constitution; people with severe moist skin, erosion or inflammation; people who are hypersensitive to propylene glycol. This medicine is for external use only; do not take it by mouth or inhale it. Take care to keep it out of the eyes; if it gets into the eyes, rinse them with water. If the symptoms are severe, seek treatment from an ophthalmologist. People with particularly delicate skin must not use it continuously on the same area. Each application should last about 4 to 5 hours; do not use it on the same area for a long time. Do not cover or wrap the application site, and do not expose it to external heat or hot water. If the affected area is wet with sweat or the like, wipe it dry before use. If water touches the area where the medicine was applied, you may feel strong irritation. If your symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 applications of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. When it is used by a child, use it under the supervision of a guardian. Follow the prescribed dosage and directions. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: rash and redness; swelling; itching; pain; swelling. Store at room temperature, protected from moisture and light. Keep out of reach of children. Do not use the product after its expiry date.
